name: Desert Crossroads
_doc: A 1v1 desert map (P3-23): both bases sit in the south, with a block of sandstone mesas between them, so armies meet on the northern road through an oasis town or on the narrow southern track. Mirrored across x = 128 (terrain_gen.mirror_x makes the heights exact).
_terrain_doc: height.r16 is built from terrain_gen by tools/make_heightmap.py: low dunes, mesas raised above the sand, and the oasis pond carved in the middle (deep water, impassable).
_obstacles_doc: Sandstone mesas [x_m, y_m, w_m, h_m], west side first, then their mirrors.
_civilian_doc: Oasis town houses [x_m, y_m, w_m, h_m, roof_height_m]: neutral buildings that block movement and that infantry can garrison (P3-05).
_neutral_doc: Capturable neutral buildings [building_id, x_m, y_m] (P3-08a), centered on the point; west side first, then mirrors, then any on the middle line.
_supply_doc: Per side: a safe site by the base, a west expansion behind the ridge, a north-west one, and a contested one at the oasis.
